tools.name: rg_list_grids
tools.description: List every enhanced grid (native and large) with uid, mode, rows, cols.

tools.name: rg_get_grid
tools.description: Return the JSON model of an enhanced grid by uid.

tools.name: rg_enhance_table
tools.description: Enhance a native {{table}} block by uid without focusing it.

tools.name: rg_restore_native
tools.description: Restore an enhanced native grid to a plain Roam table by uid.

tools.name: rg_create_table
tools.description: Create a new native grid. Requires parent_uid or after_uid so it never depends on focus.

tools.name: rg_set_cell
tools.description: Set a cell value via the v1 patch surface (row/col 0-indexed). Formulas begin with `=` but not `==`.

tools.name: rg_add_formula
tools.description: Set a formula cell. A leading `=` is added if missing; `==` is refused.

tools.name: rg_apply_patch
tools.description: Apply one or more v1 grid patches (object or array) by uid.

tools.name: rg_resize_table
tools.description: Resize a native grid by uid. rows/cols clamped to 1-20.

tools.name: rg_list_templates
tools.description: List saved grid template names (registry and store).

tools.name: rg_create_from_template
tools.description: Insert a grid from a saved template. parent_uid is required so it never depends on focus.

tools.name: rg_insert_rows
tools.description: Insert rows into an enhanced grid by uid. Default count 1.

tools.name: rg_insert_cols
tools.description: Insert columns into an enhanced grid by uid. Default count 1.

tools.name: rg_delete_rows
tools.description: Delete rows from an enhanced grid by uid. Default count 1. Refuses to delete the last row.

tools.name: rg_delete_cols
tools.description: Delete columns from an enhanced grid by uid. Default count 1. Refuses to delete the last column.

tools.name: rg_get_cell
tools.description: Return { raw, value } for a cell. value evaluates formulas via FormulaEngine.

tools.name: rg_fill
tools.description: Fill a rectangular region starting at (start_row, start_col) with values (array of arrays of strings).

tools.name: rg_merge
tools.description: Merge a range of cells. Refuses a single cell and nonempty covered cells.

tools.name: rg_unmerge
tools.description: Unmerge the merge region containing (row, col).

tools.name: rg_sort
tools.description: Sort rows by a column. direction must be "asc" or "desc". Header rows (frozenRows) stay put.

tools.name: rg_export_grid
tools.description: Export an enhanced grid as text. format one of csv|tsv|markdown|json. No file download.

tools.name: rg_insert_chart
tools.description: Insert a chart spec onto the model. type one of line|column|bar|scatter. No UI picker.

tools.name: rg_create_table_from_rows
tools.description: Create a native {{table}} from cell text, with merges, header rows, alignment, and widths. One write when every cell round-trips. Requires parent_uid or after_uid.

tools.name: rg_apply_layout
tools.description: Set merges, header rows, frozen rows, alignment, and widths on an existing native {{table}} by uid, enhancing it first if needed. Omitted fields keep their current layout.

tools.name: bt_get_projects
tools.description: List projects tracked by Better Tasks.

tools.name: bt_get_waiting_for
tools.description: List waiting-for values tracked by Better Tasks.

tools.name: bt_get_context
tools.description: List context values tracked by Better Tasks.

tools.name: bt_get_attributes
tools.description: Get Better Tasks attribute schema and configured labels.

tools.name: bt_search
tools.description: Search Better Tasks tasks by status, due, project, assignee, or free text.

tools.name: bt_create
tools.description: Create a new Better Tasks task. Use attributes object for repeat, start, defer, due, completed, project, gtd, waitingFor, context, priority, energy, depends, parent. Top-level attribute keys also accepted.

tools.name: bt_modify
tools.description: Modify an existing Better Tasks task. Use attributes object for repeat, start, defer, due, completed, project, gtd, waitingFor, context, priority, energy, depends, parent. Top-level attribute keys also accepted.

tools.name: bt_bulk_modify
tools.description: Modify multiple tasks in a single operation. Each item supports text, status, and attributes. Top-level attribute keys also accepted per item.

tools.name: bt_bulk_snooze
tools.description: Snooze multiple tasks by shifting existing defer/start/due dates forward by a number of days.

tools.name: bt_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete a Better Tasks task block AND its entire subtree (child blocks, structural subtasks, activity history). References from other tasks' depends/parent attributes are cleaned first; explicit subtasks elsewhere lose their parent link. The user is

tools.name: bt_bulk_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete multiple Better Tasks task blocks and their entire subtrees. References from other tasks' depends/parent attributes are cleaned first. Requires confirm: true.

tools.name: bt_get_analytics
tools.description: Task analytics: overdue count, completion rate, velocity by project and time period.

tools.name: bt_get_task_by_uid
tools.description: Fetch a single task by its block UID. Returns full task details including attributes.

tools.name: bt_get_analytics_detailed
tools.description: Detailed task analytics: summary, completion over time, time to completion distribution, overdue frequency, project breakdown, recurring adherence, and busiest-days heatmap.

tools.name: bt_get_suggestions
tools.description: Advisory task suggestions from local heuristics: snooze counts, weekday completion patterns, weekly load balancing, stalled tasks, and recurring adherence. Read-only — never applies changes.

tools.name: bt_export
tools.description: Export tasks as JSON, CSV, or ICS. Returns the data (does not trigger browser download).

tools.name: bt_list_templates
tools.description: List saved task templates.

tools.name: bt_create_from_template
tools.description: Create a new task from a saved template. Resolves parameters and creates the task with subtasks.

tools.name: bt_manage_templates
tools.description: Manage task templates: create, update, delete, or duplicate.

tools.name: os_random_strategy
tools.description: Return a random Oblique Strategy — a lateral-thinking prompt from Brian Eno and Peter Schmidt's card deck.

tools.name: compass_get_neighborhood
tools.description: Return Compass's structured directional neighborhood around a page or block uid (or page_title).

tools.name: px_list_regions
tools.description: List Plexus Excalidraw region blocks across the graph, or for one drawing_uid.

tools.name: px_get_region
tools.description: Return parsed metadata, caption, drawing reference, and referencing backlink uids for one Plexus region block.
